name: Ibama Kouji
source:
Yuka’s childhood friend. He dated Yuka several times in the past, but they broke up because he couldn’t shake the feeling that something wasn’t quite right when they were a couple, and he vowed never to date her again. However, after they both enrolled in the same university and moved to Tokyo together, they maintained the same close friendship they’d had in the past.
He hopes that a decent guy will step up and take on the role of making Yuka happy as his girlfriend—something he himself was unable to do.
